headline: Your Citrusbug waterfall journey.
subheadline: A scrollable GTMx strategy artifact for routing mid-market healthcare, FinTech, logistics, and real-estate buyers into the right Citrusbug AI build, dedicated engineering, or AI Readiness offer. List building, campaign angles, and sample copy, prepared for Divyansh Khandelwal.
productSummary: Citrusbug Technolabs (citrusbug.com; HQ Itasca, IL; founded 2013) is an award-winning AI development agency — not a SaaS product. They help growing businesses identify where AI, automation, and digital products create real value, then design, build, deploy, and support the solution. Three entry points on the homepage: Consulting (discovery, assessment, architecture, roadmap), Solutions (platform around a defined operational problem), and Services (AI, cloud, data, design, testing, development capacity). Aitiate is the dedicated AI arm co-founded with Citrusbug leadership. Featured industries: Healthcare, FinTech, Logistics, Real Estate. Public proof: 500+ projects delivered, 98% client retention, 4.7 on Clutch; GDPR / HIPAA / ISO/IEC 27001 posture; case outcomes include Phelix (70% of patient communication automated on a platform supporting 31M+ patients in Canada), Sully AI (45% admin workload cut, 2x workflow throughput), Valene Health (50% admin cut, 28% lower operating costs, 30% fewer no-shows), Cicada (<200ms order latency, 99.99% uptime), Handoff (95% estimation accuracy, 60% faster decisions), Zest AI (80% of lending decisions automated, 25%+ lift in loan approvals). Divyansh Khandelwal is Co-Founder / Head of Client Solutions & Strategy.
coreInsight: Divyansh sells one AI + digital engineering partner (Citrusbug + Aitiate), not a different product per vertical. Healthcare vs FinTech vs logistics vs real estate is a merge tag after routing, not a second waterfall. The single routing signal is eng_ai_hiring_state from LinkedIn Jobs + careers scrape: open AI/ML/GenAI roles, open software IC roles without AI roles, product/digital/innovation leadership hiring, or none of those. That ladder maps to Citrusbug's live entry points — AI build / Aitiate delivery, Solutions + Services capacity, AI Readiness consulting, then a soft remaining-TAM playbook.

sections.label: Signal
sections.title: The signal is how the company is already staffing AI and engineering
sections.takeaway: LinkedIn Jobs + careers already show open AI/ML roles, software IC roles, product/digital leadership hiring, or none of those. That eng_ai_hiring_state is stronger than a title guess and cheap to collect.

sections.label: Waterfall
sections.title: One cascade routes every in-TAM mid-market buyer
sections.takeaway: First match wins. AI/ML hiring first, then software IC hiring without AI roles, then product/digital leadership hiring, then every remaining in-TAM company in Citrusbug's industries.

sections.label: Tiers
sections.title: Each hiring state gets a different first offer
sections.takeaway: AI/ML hiring gets an AI Delivery Partner Brief. Software IC hiring gets a Dedicated Build / Capacity Brief. Leadership-only hiring gets an AI Readiness Assessment. The rest get the AI Opportunity Playbook.

sections.label: Campaigns
sections.title: Partner the AI build, fill eng capacity, open readiness, then cover the rest
sections.takeaway: The list is always mid-market buyers in Citrusbug's named industries. Vertical (healthcare, FinTech, logistics, real estate) is a merge tag. A/Bs sit on exclusive routes (speed-to-production vs Secure ADLC / compliance).

sections.label: Email Copy
sections.title: Copy that names the hiring state already visible on LinkedIn
sections.takeaway: Notice the open AI or eng role, poke the build-speed / ownership / blueprint pain that state implies, then ask for a one-letter yes.

sections.label: Launch
sections.title: Launch the AI/ML hiring route first
sections.takeaway: Start where they already post AI/ML/GenAI roles and still feel hiring lag vs production pressure. Prove reply density, then roll software IC hiring, leadership-only readiness, and the remaining-TAM catch-all.

signalReasons: Apollo / LinkedIn Sales Nav industry + headcount filters on healthcare, FinTech, logistics, and real estate (plus adjacent digital-product buyers Citrusbug already serves) are the commercial TAM Divyansh sells into. Public global TAM account count is not published on citrusbug.com; treat size as estimated (see citrusbug-magnet-flags.txt) and keep each launch tier ≥~1,500 contacts where possible.

The same Jobs + careers pull returns eng_ai_hiring_state: AI/ML/GenAI/Data Science roles; software IC roles (full-stack, backend, frontend, mobile, platform, DevOps) without AI roles; product / digital / innovation leadership roles — enough to route without a second expensive enrichment product.

The ladder maps to live Citrusbug positioning on citrusbug.com (Consulting → Solutions → Services, AI Readiness path, Aitiate AI arm, Secure ADLC) plus published outcomes (500+ projects, 98% retention, Phelix / Sully / Valene healthcare proof).
Buyer title (CTO / VP Eng / Head of Product / Founder) and vertical are scrape filters and merge tags, not a second waterfall. Apollo is email last after the account is routed.

sources.name: Apollo + LinkedIn Sales Nav (industry + mid-market headcount)
sources.delivers: In-TAM companies in healthcare, FinTech, logistics, real estate (and adjacent digital-product buyers). The TAM spine.

sources.name: LinkedIn Jobs + careers page scrape
sources.delivers: eng_ai_hiring_state: open AI/ML/GenAI roles, software IC roles, product/digital leadership roles.

sources.name: Company website / product / AI-initiative scrape
sources.delivers: Public AI feature pages, 'powered by AI' claims, and modernization language used as copy context — not a second waterfall axis.

sources.name: Apollo (after qualification)
sources.delivers: Work emails for CTO / VP Engineering / Head of Product / Founder titles on already-routed accounts.

sources.name: Optional Citrusbug / Aitiate customer suppress
sources.delivers: Current-customer exclusion when the signal is visible. Treat as suppress, not a tier.

routingRules.if: in_tam AND ai_role_open = true (AI Engineer, ML Engineer, LLM/GenAI, Data Scientist, MLOps, Computer Vision, NLP) AND not already_customer
routingRules.why: They are already staffing AI. Strongest intent for a Citrusbug / Aitiate build partner using published delivery proof (500+ projects, 98% retention, Phelix / Sully / Valene outcomes).

routingRules.if: in_tam AND eng_ic_role_open = true (Full-Stack, Backend, Frontend, Mobile, Platform, DevOps) AND ai_role_open = false AND not already_customer
routingRules.why: They need engineering capacity now. Maps to Citrusbug Solutions + Services (dedicated team / custom platform) without inventing an AI hire they have not posted.

routingRules.if: in_tam AND leadership_role_open = true (CTO, VP Engineering, Head of Product/Digital/Innovation, Chief Digital Officer) AND no Tier 1-2 match AND not already_customer
routingRules.why: Leadership is hiring to own the roadmap. Maps to Citrusbug Consulting / AI Readiness path — clarity before build.

routingRules.if: in_tam AND none of the above
routingRules.why: Still in TAM (mid-market buyers in Citrusbug's named industries). Softest CTA around practical AI value and Secure ADLC delivery. Mandatory 100% coverage.

tiers.name: Tier 1
tiers.label: Open AI / ML / GenAI / Data-for-AI roles
tiers.trigger: LinkedIn Jobs or careers page lists AI Engineer, ML Engineer, LLM/GenAI, Data Scientist, MLOps, Computer Vision, or NLP roles; not already a Citrusbug / Aitiate customer
tiers.pain: They are already trying to hire AI talent and still feel slow time-to-production, thin MLOps, and ownership risk while the business waits on models that should already be in workflow.
tiers.valueProp: AI Delivery Partner Brief: Citrusbug + Aitiate as the build partner that blueprints before code, ships Secure ADLC, and anchors to published outcomes (500+ projects, 98% retention, Phelix 70% patient-comms automation / 31M+ patients).
tiers.dataSource: LinkedIn Jobs + careers scrape for AI/ML/GenAI role titles
tiers.replyDensity: Highest - they already budget AI delivery
tiers.accounts: est. flagged; not published on citrusbug.com — keep each tier ≥~1,500 contacts before launch when the TAM allows

tiers.name: Tier 2
tiers.label: Open software IC roles, no AI roles
tiers.trigger: In-TAM company posts Full-Stack, Backend, Frontend, Mobile, Platform, or DevOps IC roles with no Tier-1 AI/ML roles open
tiers.pain: Open eng seats usually mean roadmap pressure and delivery lag — custom platforms and integrations slip while the team stays understaffed.
tiers.valueProp: Dedicated Build / Capacity Brief: Citrusbug Solutions + Services as a business-first discovery → blueprint → secure delivery partner, not a body shop lecture.
tiers.dataSource: LinkedIn Jobs + careers scrape for software IC titles without AI roles
tiers.replyDensity: High - visible capacity pain, AI angle secondary

tiers.name: Tier 3
tiers.label: Product / digital / innovation leadership hiring only
tiers.trigger: In-TAM company posts CTO, VP Engineering, Head of Product/Digital/Innovation, or CDO roles with no Tier 1-2 IC matches
tiers.pain: New digital leadership usually inherits ambiguity — where AI creates value vs where it cannot — before any build decision is safe.
tiers.valueProp: AI Readiness Assessment: Citrusbug Consulting path — structured discovery, honest opportunity mapping, risk/cost framing before commitment (homepage AI Readiness positioning).
tiers.dataSource: LinkedIn Jobs + careers for product/digital leadership titles
tiers.replyDensity: Medium - clear roadmap pain, longer sales cycle

tiers.name: Catch-all
tiers.label: Remaining in-TAM mid-market buyers
tiers.trigger: In-TAM company in Citrusbug's named industries (healthcare, FinTech, logistics, real estate / adjacent) with a CTO / VP Eng / Head of Product / Founder buyer and no Tier 1-3 eng_ai_hiring_state
tiers.pain: Most mid-market teams know AI matters but are unsure where it fits operations or whether the investment is worth it yet — so experiments stall and vendors pitch templates.
tiers.valueProp: Soft AI Opportunity Playbook: practical AI value framing, Secure ADLC posture (GDPR / HIPAA / ISO/IEC 27001), and Citrusbug's consulting → solutions → services path. Soft CTA.
tiers.dataSource: Apollo / Sales Nav after in_tam gate
tiers.accounts: est. flagged; catch-all must cover remaining TAM

campaigns.strategy: Lead with open {{eng_role}} seats, offer Dedicated Build / Capacity Brief for Citrusbug Solutions + Services (blueprint before build, Secure ADLC).
campaigns.value: Fill delivery capacity without a template agency
campaigns.overview: Second exclusive route. Capacity / time-to-ship angle.

campaigns.name: Leadership hiring → AI Readiness
campaigns.strategy: Lead with {{leadership_role}} open, offer AI Readiness Assessment — discovery and opportunity mapping before any build commitment.
campaigns.value: Clarity on where AI pays before engineering spend
campaigns.overview: Third exclusive route. Consulting / readiness angle.

campaigns.name: Remaining mid-market buyers
campaigns.strategy: Soft AI Opportunity Playbook. A/B practical-value vs Secure ADLC / compliance lines. Soft CTA.
campaigns.value: Simple path into Citrusbug consulting or a scoped build

launchPlan: Suppress visible Citrusbug / Aitiate customers first when Divyansh can share a customer list.
Launch Tier 1 AI/ML-hiring AI Delivery Partner Brief; hold until ≥~1,500 contacts when TAM allows, else run smaller waves with longer reply-density read.
Roll Tier 2 software-IC Dedicated Build / Capacity Brief, then Tier 3 leadership-only AI Readiness Assessment.
Open Catch-all AI Opportunity Playbook for remaining TAM.

Keep vertical (healthcare, FinTech, logistics, real estate) as a merge tag only — do not split into parallel waterfalls.
